questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Choose the courses that interest you
Try to speak to French students, they are very nice and open, once you talk to them
Enjoy the beautiful libraries!

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: The French students do not read as much as in Copenhagen because there is no curriculum, but do not stress about this, just read what interests you and follow the courses, because the exam questions are about what you learn in the courses. So it is very imporatat to go to class and listen more than reading other stuff yourself

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: I got the grades I had hoped for, because I worked very hard for it, so I am proud of myself

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The many words I did not know in the beginning

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: It was an amazing experience, thanks! The only things are all the administrative things that take a biiit too long time I think... But I don't know if it is possible to change that
